mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing inflationary pressure and prompting the Fed to delay rate hikes, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) below 1,400,000 units in two consecutive months signals a collapse in housing demand, triggering a broader economic slowdown narrative that leads to equity market repricing and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 1,400.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a broad-based supply-side contraction and labor market stress, which together signal an impending recession and trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 2% in 3 months AND UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO), indicates a collapse in aggregate demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month MA AND INDPRO declines > 1.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the joint effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 per month for three consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 50.0 for 3 consecutive months AND UNRATE > 4.8%
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) on a year-over-year basis, combined with a drop in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a broad economic contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.
